Flow.label: Opportunity - Screen Flow - Co-Sell Questionnaire

fields.name: Copy_1_of_fault_DisplayText3
fields.fieldText:
Oops!


It appears there's been an issue trying to do submit the approvals for this Co-Sell. You can try again or you can notify Sales Systems by logging an ServiceNow ticket. Please include the information below in the ticket.


PLEASE NOTE: In order to be successful in submitting the opportunity for Co-Sell approval, you must be either the Opportunity owner or the creator of the Opportunity Partner.


{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

fields.name: Header
fields.fieldText: If No Partner Co-Seller, please select “None”

fields.name: Q1_Provided_Consistent_Value
fields.fieldText: Which Partner provided CONSISTENT business value (pre-sales, business relationship, Tanium value messaging to the customer) or technical value (Tanium Demo, Proof of Concept, Whiteboarding) to help Tanium win the business?

fields.name: Q2_Added_Value_to_Complete_Solution
fields.fieldText: Which Partner brought together additional (non-Tanium) critical value technology, integrations, or stakeholders to complete the solution for the customer?

fields.name: Sales_Relationships_w_decision_makers
fields.fieldText: Which Partner has the most previously successful sales relationships with key decision-makers in the account?

fields.name: Actively_engaged_in_strategy_content
fields.fieldText: Which Partner is the most engaged in developing sales strategy & content, and in presenting to the customer either independently or with Tanium account resources, throughout the entire sales cycle?

fields.name: Involved_in_RFP_creation
fields.fieldText: Which Partner helped prepare the RFP and/or owns the completion of the response to the customer?

fields.name: Assumed_contractual_risk
fields.fieldText: Which Partner assumes risk as the counter-party on the contract with the end customer?

fields.name: Integrated_non_Tanium_Products_Services
fields.fieldText: Which Partner brought together other (non-Tanium) critical products/ services to complete the solution for the customer?
